Class PaymentAuthorizationPostProcessor

public without sharing class PaymentAuthorizationPostProcessor
implements ReplicationSettingsPostProcessor

Post-processes StripeTransaction__c records to create related PaymentAuthorization__c records. Implements the ReplicationSettingsPostProcessor interface and is automatically invoked after a StripeTransaction__c record is saved via webhook integration. Extracts payment method details from the Stripe webhook payload and creates corresponding payment authorization records with card or card-present information. Uses field mapping settings to transform payment method details from the Stripe payload into Salesforce payment authorization records, then links the authorization back to the original transaction.

public static void executeBatch(Map<Id, JSONUtils.JSONRecord> payloadsById)

Processes multiple StripeTransaction__c records in batch to create PaymentAuthorization__c records. Extracts payment method details from Stripe webhook payloads, uses field mapping to create payment authorization records, upserts them in bulk, and links them back to the original Stripe transactions. Logs errors for any failed operations.

Parameters:
    payloadsById – Map of StripeTransaction__c IDs to their corresponding JSON webhook payloads

private static FieldMappingEngine getMappingEngine(String mappingSettings)

Retrieves or creates a FieldMappingEngine instance for the specified mapping settings. Uses static cache to avoid recreating mapping engines for the same settings within the transaction.

Parameters:
    mappingSettings – Name of the field mapping settings to use

Returns:
    FieldMappingEngine: Cached or newly created mapping engine instance
